# Protein intake

## Target
1.6 g per kg, at 61 kg that's about 100 g a day. Dietitian at the sports med clinic (Hannah Lefebvre, one visit 2025-04-23, $140, 80% covered) said 1.4 to 1.8 is fine for marathon plus lifting, spread over 4 meals of 25 to 30 g. Before that I was eating maybe 60 g on shift days without noticing.

## What a normal day looks like
| meal | food | protein |
|---|---|---|
| breakfast | 3 eggs + toast | 21 g |
| shift lunch | chicken and rice bowl from [[Meal prep Sundays]] | 34 g |
| snack | Oikos Pro yogurt 0%, 175 g | 20 g |
| dinner | tofu, tempeh or fish, veg | 25 g |
| total | | 100 g |

Night shift version: same but the "lunch" happens at 1 am and the yogurt at 4 am.

## Powder
Kaizen Naturals whey isolate, vanilla, 2.27 kg tub $69.99 at Costco, 27 g per scoop. One scoop in oats after the long run. Tried a pea protein (Vega) and it tasted like a lawn.

## Tracking
Cronometer for 2 weeks in May 2025:
- average 94 g/day
- lowest 58 g (2025-05-12, first night shift, ate vending machine pretzels)
- highest 131 g (Sunday, long run plus Dev's BBQ)

Bone broth counts a little, 9 g a cup from the batch in [[Stock from scratch]]. Lifting days in [[Krafttraining Plan]] get the full 100+, rest days I don't stress.
